name: Teaparty in Candyworld
source:
Amazing adventures, games, fun and imminent death await you here.
How fortunate that you've woken up right now - very soon, a magical tea party will take place in the Cloudhouse, which all residents of Candyworld dream of attending. You should definitely get to know them - we all love guests very much!

At the tea party, you will meet our incomparable Redheart Queen - there is no other person more beautiful and kind in the world! The queen will fulfill any wish that her loyal subjects make at a tea party. I hope you know what you're going to wish for.

The road to the palace may seem difficult to you - on your way you will encounter many dangers and mysteries. But believe me, your suffering is nothing compared to the greatness of our queen!
I've heard that since your arrival in Candyworld, the memory of the past has left you. Perhaps you would like to restore it? The queen will help you with this matter, but remember: the less you know, the more blissfully you sleep.

Accept this invitation - I will be waiting for you in the Cloudhouse. And don't forget to smile, because life in Candyworld is a miracle!

Yours truly, Porcelainy - the royal messenger.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524070/Teaparty_in_Candyworld/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
奇妙的冒险、游戏、乐趣和迫在眉睫的死亡在这里等待着你。
多么幸运，你现在就醒了——很快，一场神奇的茶会将在云屋举行，这是所有糖果世界的居民都梦想参加的。你绝对应该了解一下他们 - 我们都非常喜欢房客！

在茶会上，你将见到我们无与伦比的红心女王——世界上没有比她更美丽、更善良的人了！女王会满足她忠实臣民在茶会上提出的任何愿望。我希望你知道你想要什么。

通往宫殿的道路对你来说可能看起来很困难——在你的路上你会遇到许多危险和谜团。但请相信我，与我们女王的伟大相比，你的痛苦根本算不了什么！
我听说自从你来到糖果世界之后，过去的记忆就消失了。也许你想恢复它？女王会帮你解决这件事，但请记住：你知道的越少，你睡得就越幸福。

接受这个邀请吧——我会在云屋等你。别忘了微笑，因为糖果世界的生活是一个奇迹！

此致，瓷器——皇家使者。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524070/Teaparty_in_Candyworld/]Steam[/url]]
